# XYZ Lab

> XYZ Lab is a digital marketing tutorial site offering step-by-step video guides, benchmarks, and courses on paid advertising, analytics, AI tools, SEO, eCommerce, web builders, and social media platforms.

## Courses

- [Google Ads Course](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads-course/): Master Google Ads with AI — campaign setup, Smart Bidding, keyword research, and ROAS optimisation.
- [Meta Ads Course](https://xyzlab.com/meta-ads-course/): Complete Meta Ads training covering Facebook and Instagram advertising.
- [SEO AIO Course](https://xyzlab.com/seo-aio-course/): All-in-one SEO course covering on-page, technical, and off-page optimisation.
- [AI Marketing Analytics Course](https://xyzlab.com/ai-marketing-analytics-course/): Use AI to analyse and report on marketing performance.
- [AI Content Creation Course](https://xyzlab.com/ai-content-creation-course/): Create marketing content faster using AI tools.
- [Vibe Coding Course](https://xyzlab.com/vibe-coding-course/): Build web projects using AI-assisted coding.

## Google Ads Tutorials

- [Google Ads](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/): Hub for all Google Ads video tutorials.
- [Tracking Template](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/tracking-template/): Add UTM tracking templates to Google Ads campaigns.
- [Lead Form](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/lead-form/): Set up lead form extensions in Google Ads.
- [Customer Lists](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/customer-lists/): Upload and use customer match lists.
- [Sitelinks](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/sitelinks/): Add sitelink extensions to ads.
- [Location Targeting](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/location-targeting/): Target specific geographic locations.
- [Manual CPC](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/manual-cpc/): Switch to manual CPC bidding strategy.
- [Target ROAS](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/target-roas/): Set up Target ROAS smart bidding.
- [Manager Account](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/manager-account/): Create and manage a Google Ads MCC.
- [Campaign ID](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/campaign-id/): Find your Google Ads campaign ID.
- [Change History](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/change-history/): View change history in a Google Ads account.
- [Download Leads](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/download-leads/): Export lead form submissions from Google Ads.
- [New Account](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/new-account/): Create a new Google Ads account.
- [Setup Google Ads Tag](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/setup-google-ads-tag/): Install the Google Ads global site tag.
- [Setup Conversions via GTM](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/setup-conversions-google-tag-manager/): Configure conversion tracking through Google Tag Manager.
- [Import Google Analytics Events](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/import-google-analytics-events/): Import GA4 conversions into Google Ads.
- [PMax Audience Signal](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/pmax-audience-signal/): Add audience signals to Performance Max campaigns.
- [Google Ads Benchmarks](https://xyzlab.com/google-ads/benchmarks/): Industry benchmark data for Google Ads by country.
